Task: Explain why the sky appears blue, in three sentences.

steps.action:
The sky appears blue due to a phenomenon called **Rayleigh scattering**, in which sunlight interacts with gas molecules in Earth's atmosphere. Because blue light has a shorter wavelength than other colors in the visible spectrum, it is scattered far more efficiently in all directions by these molecules. When you look at any part of the sky away from the sun, your eyes receive this scattered blue light, making the sky appear blue.
